heading: 2.2 Literal syntax
text:
### 2.2 Literal syntax [LUNI.2.2]

`INT_LIT / INT_LIT` — wherever it appears in DS — produces a `Rational` node,
reduced to lowest terms at parse time. This is uniform across all contexts:
unit expressions, const declarations, rule expressions. There are no
exceptions.

Division by literal zero is a compile error (`DS_VALIDATE_DIV_BY_ZERO`). `//` remains floor division for
`Int // Int`. `/` with at least one non-literal operand is runtime division.
